item.title: Project EVE: What Happens When Agents Enter an Economy That Already Has One
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: this is not a review of “AI playing a game”. It is the first experiment that splits an agent economy into three billable layers — execution, tooling capital, and the cost of trust — and quotes a price for each: four months of model progress buys 3× the return; swapping the author of a scaffold moves a fleet from losing ships daily to zero losses in twelve hours; and a saboteur who is told to sabotage is almost never caught.
